script: The Japanese spider crab can measure about 3.7 meters from claw to claw. That gives it the longest legs of any known crab. Its body, though, is only about 40 centimeters wide. It lives off the coast of Japan, often 150 to 300 meters deep. Some may live for as long as 100 years. Like all crabs, it must shed its hard shell to grow.
